best_match.size: 2000 x 1250 mm (78.7 x 49.2 in) writing area; a 36 x 48 in sheet (914 x 1219 mm) fits with room to spare
best_match.accuracy: Repeat positioning +/-0.1 mm (manufacturer spec). Absolute accuracy across the sheet NOT FOUND, so the +/-0.2 mm target is unconfirmed.
best_match.pens: Pen holder takes pens up to 17.5 mm diameter, 0-90 deg angle. Covers a 16 mm Posca and gel pens on paper spec; not tested.
best_match.shipping: Free worldwide shipping claimed. Shipping policy: duties covered by UUNA TEK when shipped by sea (1 month or longer); air option leaves US duty to the buyer. Oversized machines (1.25 x 2 m / 2 x 2 m) take 4 weeks to produce. Sales tax NOT FOUND (calculated at checkout).
best_match.included: Plotter x1 and accessory kit (power adapter set, data cable, auxiliary regulator board). WiFi and SD card standard. UUNA TEK 3.0 software; also runs from Inkscape, UGS, LightBurn, LaserGRBL. 8 mm tempered glass base plate. Stand or legs: NOT FOUND, not listed in package inclusions.
best_match.notes: MANUFACTURER page and store catalog loaded 2026-10-05. Price unchanged from the earlier pass. Halloween sale banner with a countdown timer; sale end date NOT FOUND. No smaller fitting variant: the only sizes listed are 2 x 1.25 m and 2 x 2 m. The page advertises custom sizes up to 4 x 2 m, but no custom price is listed (would need a quote). No required paid add-ons found: the $500 'New Licence' product is only for second-hand machines. Returns allowed within 30 days, but the buyer pays return shipping for non-defect returns. The air shipping option relies on declaring a $125 invoice value; the sea option, where UUNA TEK pays duty, avoids that. All-in: $6,299 + sales tax (NOT FOUND).
